DOCUMENT
Cleaning guide, revision 1.0
Immediate response to a coffee spill
Blot the spill immediately with a clean white absorbent cloth. Do not rub the fabric.
Mix 5 mL of neutral liquid soap with 250 mL of lukewarm water.
Test the solution on a hidden area and wait until the test area is dry.
Dab from the outer edge toward the centre, using only enough solution to dampen the surface.
Remove soap residue with a separate cloth lightly dampened with clean water, then allow the sofa to
air dry.
Prohibited cleaning methods
Do not use chlorine bleach on the LUNARA S3 fabric.
Do not use solvent cleaners, abrasive powders, steam cleaners or direct heat.
Do not saturate the cushion or remove the fixed cover for machine washing.
Use only the instructions identified for product code LUN-S3-2401. Care instructions for rugs, leather
or other furniture do not apply.

Drink stain procedure
Blot the floor covering and rinse the spot with cool water using a wet-extraction machine.
For this white polypropylene rug only, a solution of 10 mL chlorine bleach in 1 litre of water may be
used after a hidden-area test.
Rinse the treated area twice and extract as much water as possible.

Temperature management and code E06
The Aster M55 monitors internal airflow and temperature near the upper rear ventilation path.
E06 meaning
On the Aster M55, error E06 indicates a temperature-sensor fault or an implausible reading from the
internal thermal monitoring circuit.
Immediate action
Switch the television off, unplug it and allow it to cool for at least 20 minutes. Confirm that the upper and rear
ventilation openings are clear and that the specified clearances are available.
When service is required
If E06 returns soon after a cool start in an adequately ventilated position, disconnect the product and contact
Aster service. Do not remove the rear cover or attempt to replace the sensor.
Related shutdown
A protection shutdown without E06 can also occur when room temperature is excessive or vents are obstructed;
correct the installation before restarting.
Error meanings are product-specific. This E06 definition applies to Aster M55, product code AST-M55-2024.

Safety information
Observe these instructions throughout installation and use. Improper mounting, ventilation or cleaning can
damage the television or create a risk of injury.
Electrical safety
Use the supplied mains lead with a correctly earthed indoor outlet. Disconnect the plug during thunderstorms,
before cleaning, and when the television will not be used for an extended period. Never handle the plug with wet
hands.
Ventilation and heat
Leave at least 10 cm around the upper and side ventilation openings. Do not install the set inside a sealed
cabinet or near a radiator, cooking appliance, candle or other heat source.
Children and stability
Furniture and wall fixings must support the television safely. Route cables so that they cannot be pulled or tripped
over. Never allow a child to climb on the television or its furniture.
G
Do not remove the rear cover; there are no user-serviceable parts inside.
G
Keep liquids, aerosol cleaners and small metal objects away from openings.
G
If smoke, an unusual smell or crackling occurs, unplug the set and contact authorised service.
G
Two adults should lift and move the television; hold the lower frame, not the panel.

bracket and spacer arrangement. The wall and anchors must be assessed by a competent installer.
Cable access

antenna cables.

Picture settings
Picture modes provide a starting point; adjustments are stored separately for each input and dynamic-range
format.
Recommended starting modes
Standard suits mixed daytime use. Cinema uses warmer colour and reduced processing for film material. Game
reduces input latency when a console is connected. Vivid is intended for bright retail environments and may
exaggerate colour.
Backlight and brightness
Backlight changes panel illumination. Brightness changes the black-level reference and should normally remain
near its default. Excessive sharpness can add visible halos.
High dynamic range
HDR is detected automatically from compatible HDMI and streaming sources. Dynamic tone mapping may be
enabled for bright rooms, but can alter intended highlight detail.

completing an authentication and capability exchange.

connection before changing resolution settings.

Error codes
An error code identifies the subsystem that reported a problem. It does not by itself prove that a hardware repair
is required.
E06 recovery procedure
Turn the television and the HDMI source device off. Unplug both devices from mains power for 60
seconds. Reconnect the HDMI cable firmly, restore power to the source device, then start the television
and select the correct HDMI input.
If E06 returns
Test another HDMI input and a known-good certified cable. Connect the source directly to the television,
temporarily removing switches, splitters, capture devices or receivers. Set the source to a supported resolution. If
the same error remains with more than one source, record the affected input and contact service.

System reset and software update
Use the least disruptive recovery action first. A restart preserves settings; a factory reset removes them.
Restart
Hold the remote Power key for five seconds and choose Restart. This reloads system services without removing
channels, applications or accounts.
Software update
Open Settings › System › Software Update and choose Check now. Keep mains power connected until the
television restarts. Updates may change menu wording or app compatibility.
Factory reset
Open Settings › System › Reset and enter the local PIN. This removes tuned channels, network credentials,
installed app data and account sign-ins. External storage is not erased.
Recovery after interruption
If an update was interrupted and the television does not start normally, disconnect external equipment,
power-cycle the set once and contact authorised service with the status-lamp pattern.
Do not perform repeated factory resets for an E06 connection error; complete the HDMI checks on page 17 first.

11. Troubleshooting and code H17
This page applies specifically to the Aurelia Q62, product code AUR-Q62-2026.
H17 meaning
On the Aurelia Q62, H17 means that HDMI handshake negotiation did not complete. It is commonly associated
with an inactive source, a cable connection, incompatible signal mode or a temporary HDCP negotiation failure.
First action
Turn off the television and the connected HDMI source. Unplug both devices from mains power for 60 seconds.
Reconnect the HDMI cable firmly, restore power to the source first, then start the television and select the
correct HDMI input.
If H17 remains
Try another known-good cable and another Q62 HDMI input. Confirm the source output format. Do not open the
cabinet; contact qualified service if the code persists.
What H17 does not prove
H17 describes an HDMI negotiation symptom. It does not by itself establish a manufacturing defect, lightning
strike, external surge or any other insurance cause.

8. Charge-time estimation
Required inputs
A meaningful estimate requires current SoC, target SoC and the sustained charging power. If current SoC is
missing, ask for it rather than presenting a precise full-charge time.
Energy calculation
Required battery energy equals usable capacity multiplied by the change in SoC. From 20% to 80%, the change
is 60%, so the battery receives 64 kWh x 0.60 = 38.4 kWh.
Efficiency assumption
For a planning estimate on AC, use 90% wall-to-battery efficiency unless measured data is available. Grid
energy for the 20%-to-80% example is 38.4 / 0.90 = 42.67 kWh.
Time calculation
At a sustained 11 kW, 42.67 / 11 = 3.88 hours, approximately 3 hours 53 minutes. Temperature, balancing and
load management can extend actual time.
Do not state a full-charge time when the current state of charge or sustained available power is unknown.

6. Solar-surplus charging
Energy-manager input
The W11 can receive a dynamic current setpoint over Modbus TCP from a compatible energy manager or
inverter gateway.
Operating range
Solar-surplus mode varies charging from approximately 1.4 kW single-phase equivalent control up to the
configured 11 kW maximum, subject to site configuration.
HelioSync integration
Protocol profile HS-EV-2 is compatible with the HelioSync I10 gateway when both devices use firmware listed in
their current guides.
Grid supplement
When the site setting permits grid import, the grid supplies any difference between photovoltaic output,
household demand and the requested charging power. The inverter's PV output alone does not necessarily cap
wallbox output.
Solar-surplus charging still uses the site's AC distribution system, protective devices and wallbox. It is not a direct
panel-to-vehicle connection.
